name: Verpelét (Hungary)
description: Light grey field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Verpelét: a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes and white ploughshares, between a vine and ears of grain.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Verpelét arms with vine and grain
